༄tshi/ / mchod do/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku zhi khro rabs 'byams/ sprul sku gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ yum chen smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro/ rgyal sras rig 'dzin in+t+ra bho dhi/sku'i rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gsung gi rig 'dzin nā gā 'dzu na/ thugs kyi rig 'dzin hūm̐X chen ka ra/ yon tan rig 'dzin bī ma mi tra/ 'phrin las rig 'dzin pra bha ha sti/ dbyings kyi rig 'dzin dha na saṃ kṛ ta/ mchod bstod rig 'dzin gu h+ya tsaṇ+ḍa/ drag sngags rig 'dzin shon+ti ghar+bha ste dpal gyi sprul ba rnam brgyad/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po/ las can dag pa'i 'bor dgu/ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal/ sna nam pa chen po rdo rje bdud 'joms/ sprul ba'i gter ston chen po rig 'dzin dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang rdo rje dpal ba/ mtshan ldan byams pa bshes gnyen/ rig 'dzin
༄tshi/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang / sngags 'chang chen po chos rgyal bsod nams/ yol mo sprul sku shākya bzang po/ rje btsun sprul sku chen po rig 'dzin legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang bo'i sde/ sku sras rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu/ rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyug sgam smyon phyag rdor nor bu/ rig 'dzin chen po kun bzang pad+ma phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po/ kham lung pa rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal/ kyu/ yang na/ bskal bzang pad+ma dbang phyug 'jigs med grub pa'i sde/ 'gyur med blo ldan ngag gi dbang po/ grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma bshes gnyen/ thugs sras ñcar+sha rgyan bstan 'dzin/ kun bzang 'jigs med dpa' bo/ thub bstan phyogs las rnam rgyal/ dpal chen che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/ thub bstan g.yin phan chos kyi
nyi ma la thugs gi bar du rim par brgyud pa'i rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rmya/ yang na/ pad+ma khas gnyen rjes su/ chu bzang pa ngag dbang kun bzang bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang pad+ma kun bzang / 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ thub bstan phyogs las rnam rgyal/ lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi ma/ thub bstan gzhan phan chos kyi nyi ma/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho/ nges don gsang sngags bstan 'dzin la thugs gi: sogs/ rmya/ yang na/ pad+ma dbang rgyal rjes su/ lha rigs rnal 'byor rdo rdze thog med/ bstan 'dzin ngag dbang 'phrin las dbang po/ sngags 'chang khams gsum zil gnon/ kun bzang nam mkha' klong yangs/ bskal bzang bdud 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje/ khyab bdag bla ma rgyal ba'i myu gu/ thub bstan chos dbang mnyam nyid rdo rje/ thub bstan gzhan phan chos kyi nyi ma/ sogs/ tsha gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gi 'brel ba thog pa'i dpal dpal mgon rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi dang theg pa rim dgur 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: khyad par du yang zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ khrag mthung 'bar ba lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa 'phrin las/ ma
༄༅/ /mo rbod gtong / rig 'dzin slob dpon/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ rmod pa drag sngags/ rgyal sras khyung gi lha tshogs sogs sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad khrag mthung 'bar ba bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo/ gzhan yang 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje drag po rtsal/ myang gi drag po dmar chen/ bde gshegs 'dus pa/ drag po dbu dgu ye shes rang gsal/ rat+na drag po rtsal / pad+ma drag po rtsal/ garma gu ru yang gsang drag po rtsal/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra/ rta mgrin tshar ba dmar nag bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs te rig 'dzin bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: gzhan yang 'joms byed 'char kha nag po/ khro chu dug sdong nag po/ yang bzlog me yi spu gri/ gshin rje du ri kha dang kha thun nag po/ 'joms byed zla nyi dmar nag gshin rje khri gang dmar nag drang srong lorgyu pa la/ pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i lha dgu'i
dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: gsang bdag drag pa kun 'dul yab yum gtum po khyung lnga/ 'byung bo 'dul byed/ phyag rdor khang brtsegs rnams dang / 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ta/ ma rgyud bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: yum chen rdo rje phag mo/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ sngags skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ gnas dang nye gnas/ zhing dang nye zhing / tshan rdo nye tshan/ mthong spyod nye 'thung / 'du ba nye 'du/ dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod/ gnas chen sum bcu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal duzo dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ ma ning / phyag drug gur mgon zhal bzhi pa/ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyugdpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs can/ zhal dmar mi'u thung / bka' sdod pu tra lcam sring / bram nag bshan pa drug bskor 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: dpal rdo rje nag po chen po bstan srung yongs rdzogs yab yum sras
༄tshi/ /gsum / mgon po sde lnga/ lha mo sde lnga/ las mgon bya rog gdong can/ seṅge'i gdong can/ gshin rje chos rgyal/ so ka ra tsa/ sprul ba mched gsum/ shan pa dmar nag dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ sde dpon sum bcu/ dregs pa bco brgyad/ nag po stong / sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ sprul 'khor dam can bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste dpal mgon bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma e ka dza ṭi sras mo bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: dam can dur khrod ma gsum/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ bka' srung dbang gi ma bdun/bstan srung dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: snying lhag bka' yi srung ma shan pa srog sgrub nag mo sogs dam can sde bdun/ lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod ma/ dur khrod lha mo ngan nai ma sogs rdzogs chen bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal duzo dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can/ bdud rgyal nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ phur srung dam can ma mo bcu gnyis/ ming po bse lcags dung gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: khyad par sprul ba'i chos skyong gza' mchog ra hu la yab yum sprul 'khor sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: gzhan yang dam can skyes bu chen po badz+ra thig le rtsal/ dam can rdor legs/ gnyan chen thang
lha / srog bdag yam shud dmar po/ dam can stong dpon dgra lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: sprul ba'i chos rgyal sku lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / kun khyab rdo rje drag rtsal sogs btsan rgod 'bar ba sde bdun blon po ru 'dren bran g.yog bshan pa las byed 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: khyad par 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi gter srung mthu chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / lha mo nyi ma gzhon nu/ rdo rje g.yu yi sgron ma/ lha gcig zhing skyong mched gnyis/ zhing skyong 'chi med nye dbang / dpa' bo dur khrod kyai bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: rgya gar rdo rdze gdan/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs/ go ma sa la'i mchod rten/ li yul lcang ra smug po/ kha che khri stan/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya na/ byang sham bha la sogs rgya gar rgya nag bal bod kyi gnas chen khyad par can rnams dang / khyad par bsil ldan ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir ra sa 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag khang / dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang/ khra 'brug sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang / gzhan yang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams la gnas shong / zlasab dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar bstan dang bstan
༄tshi/ /'dzin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'di nas bzung rje yi mgul lha bcugasumaman mag don rgyas pa'i mjug ltar bya/ bsdus pa'i nyin yi dmargyud sde bzhi'i mjug tu/ khyad par du yang sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad/ zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ khrag 'thung 'bar ba bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje drag po rtsal/ myang gi drag po dmar chen/ bde gshegs 'dus pa/ drag po dbu dgu ye shes rang gsal/ rat+na drag po rtsal/ pad+ma drag po rtsal/ garma gu ru yang gsang drag po rtsal/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra/ rta mgrin tshar ba dmar nag bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs te rig 'dzin bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / 'joms byed 'char kha nag po/ khro chu dug sdong nag po/ yang bzlog me yi spu gri/ gzhin rje khri gang dmar nag sogs gshin rje gshed kyi rigs gyur 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal duzo gnas chen po sum bcu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi
zhal duca dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma dpal mgon bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi lha tshogs rnams dang / phur srung dkar bdud lcam dral/ sngags srung e ka tsa ti 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du:dam can dur khrod ma gsum/ ma cig dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ bka' srung dbang gi ma bdun/ lha chen ma hā de wa/ stobs ldan dregs shul dbang po/ dregs pa srog gi spu gri/ rdo rje khams gsum zil gnon/ dregs pa g.yung mgon rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: drang srong gza' mchog chen po/ dam can rdo rje legs pa/ gnyan chen thang lha/ srog bdag yam shud dmar po/ dam can stong dpon dgra lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: sprul ba'i chos rgyal sku lnga/ btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun/ gter bsrung mthu chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: lha mo nyi ma gzhon nu/ rdo rje g.yu yi sgron ma/ ma mo brtan ma bcu gnyis / zhing skyong 'chi med nye dbang / dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams dang / rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: gzhan yang rgya dkar rgya nag bal bod kyi gnas chen khyad par can rnams la gnas shing slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum/
༄tshi/ /'bangs kyi srog lha bcu gsum/ srid pa'i lha rabs mched dgu/ gzhan yang dregs pa phyi nang gsang ba/ sprul dang / myur mgyogs/ brtags chags/ drag po sngags dang / bstan srung gi lha srin sde brgyad/ lha klu gza' dang rgyu skar 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun bcu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: yul phyogs 'di dang gnas khang 'di nyid la gnas shing rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam la btags pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal duca gzhan yang dus dang tshes grangs rnams la dbang byed cing legs nyes la ko long sdom par byed pa'i sa bdag rje blon bcu gsum/ spar kha brgyad/ sme ba dgu/ lo zla zhag dus kyi sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par du yang dmag dang zor la dga' ba'i dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: khyad par du yang rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur cing lus kyi grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i wo lha dgra lha srog lha zhang lha yul lha la sogs te 'go ba'i lha rigs gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: skyabs byed srung byed kyi lha rigs gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: dus gsum
pha ma rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron gyur ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyas pa'i nyin yi dmargyud sde bzhi'i mjug tu/ khyad par du yang bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs/ zhi ba rigs lnga yab yum/ phyi yi byang sems/ nang gi byang sems/ sprul sku bcom ldan thub drug sgo ba yab yum brgyad la sogs te bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: dkyil 'khor chen po'i pho brang dgu ling gi dbus kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po che mchog he ru ka yab yum/ lung gi he ru ka yab yum brgyad de bcu/ khro bo bcu/ sgo ba bzhi/ lce spyang ma brgyad la sogs te che mchog yon tan gyi lha tsogs rnams kyi zhal du: shar phyogs thugs kyi pho brang chen po'i dbus su dpal chen yang dag badz+ra he ru ka yab yum/ rgyud kyi he ru ka yab yum brgyad/ ko ri ma dang seng ha ma brgyad de bcu drug sgo ba bzhi/ dbang mo nyer brgyad la sogs te yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: lho phyogs sku yi pho brang chen po'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed yab yum gsum dang / gshed bzhi yab yum brgyad de bcu gcig phyogs skyong bcu gnyis yab yum/ sgo ba bzhi/ ging bzhi/ bdud bzhi/ rtsis pa bzhi/ bshan pa bzhi la sogs 'jam dpal sku gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: nub phyogs gsung gi wo brang chen po'i
༄༅/ /dbus su dpal chen pad+ma dbang chen yab yum gnyis/ dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum/ zil gnon khro bo yab yum bcu drug sgo ma bzhi/ khams rgya ma drug long ba bzhi/ lce spyang brgyad/ khyi brgyad/ pho nya 'dab chen ma bzhi/ 'brug mo bzhi ste bcom ldan 'das dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'bor drug bcu re bzhi'i lha tshogs 'bor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: byang phyogs 'phrin las phur ba'i dkyil 'bor chen po'i dbus su gtso bo dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gnyis/ sras mchog rigs bzhi yab yum/ khro bo yab yum bcu/ za gsod nye shu/ sgo ba bzhi/ shwa na bzhi/ re ma bzhi/ sa bdag bzhi/ ging bzhi/ bdud bzhi/skyes bu bzhi ste bcom ldan 'das phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: shar lho dbang drag rol ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso kro bcom ldan 'das mngon rdzogs rgyal po yab yum/ stag rgyal lnga/ bde 'gro thod phreng gnyis/ khros pa'i ma bzhi/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ thugs kyi dgyes sde bzhi/ chags byed cha snyoms gnyis/ dza ti re ti gnyis te bzhi/ smyi phud sri 'degs gnyis/ dmigs pa'i rgyal mo bzhi/ ma mo bdun/ gru 'degs bzhi/ sgo ma bzhi/ rgyal mo bzhi/ blon mo bzhi/ gdong mo bzhi/ dur khrod ma gsum/ rtsis kyi ma gsum/ gsang ba'i ma gsum la sogs ste mngon rdzogs ma mo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: lho nub chos
dbyings rol ba'i wo brang gi dbus su gtso bo rig 'dzin bla ma yab yum/ phyogs bzhir rig 'dzin bzhi/ khyams kyi slob dpon rig 'dzin brgyad/ sgo bzhir slob dpon bzhi/ dpa' bo bzhi/ mkha' 'gro bzhi la sogs te rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: nub byang mchod bstod dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dregs pa kun 'dul phyag na rdo rje yab yum gnyis/ dregs pa yab yum brgyad/ khyams la dregs pa'i sde dpon nyi shu/ sgo skyong dbang chen sde bzhi la sogs te mchod bstod dregs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: byang shar drag sngags rol ba'i pho brang chen po'i dbus su gtso bo stobs ldan nag po yab yum gnyis / dregs pa brgyad dang bcu/ 'jigs byed bcu'am dregs pa sde drug sgo ba bzhi la sogs te drag sngags rmod pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du: phyi khyams dang lcags ri la sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro so gnyis/ ging chen bco brgyad/ ma mo bdun/ sring mo bzhi/ ling ka bcu bdun/ 'bar ma brgyad/ pho nya drug bcu rtsa bzhi/ sa bdag so gnyis/ 'bum phrag yangs ba'i mkha' 'gro/ tshangs pa'i bu mo 'bum/ de bzhin du dri za/ grul bum/ bden bral/ klu dbang / rlung lha/ gnod sbyin/ dbang ldan/ sa bdag sman phran/ sha za/ bdud mo/ sngon mo/ dkar mo/ ser mo/ dmar mo/ ljang mo/ smug mo/ nag mo/ nag
༄༅/ /mo 'bum gyi gtso mo/ bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs te sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad khrag 'thung 'bar ba bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo/ gzhan yang 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje drag po rtsal/ myang gi drag po dmar chen/ bde gshegs 'dus pa/ drag po dbu dgu ye shes rang gsal/ rat+na drag po rtsal/ pad+ma drag po rtsal/ garma gu ru yang gsang drag po rtsal/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra/ rta mgrin tshar ba dmar nag bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs te rig 'dzin bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ sprul ba gsum/ gshed po bzhi/ mon bdud bcu drug 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ sgo skyong bzhi/ dkyil 'khor gyi mu ran skyong bar zhal gyi bzhes pa'i sgrol ging las gshin bye ba sa ya 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal duzo gzhan yang 'joms byed 'char kha nag po/ khro chu dug sdong nag po/ yang bzlog me yi spu gri/ gshin rje du ri kha dang kha thun
nag po/ 'joms byed zla nyi dmar nag gshin rje k+ki gang dmar nag drang srong lolta pā la/ pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu phyogs bcu khro ba'i dkyil 'bor/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'bor/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'drar la sogs te dkyil 'bor rnam pa gsum gyi lha tshogs 'bor dang bcas pa'i zhal du:gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul yab yum/ gtum po khyung lnga/ 'byung bo 'dul byed/ phyag rdor khang brtsegs rnams dang / 'jam dpal nā ga rak+ta/ ma rgyud bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: yum chen rdo rje phag mo/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ sngags skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ gnas dang nye gnas/ zhing dang nye zhing / tshan rdo nye tshan/ 'thung spyod nye 'thung / 'du ba nye 'du/ du khrod nye ba'i dur khrod/gnas chen sum bcu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ ma ning / phyag drug gur mgon/ zhal
༄༅/ /bzhi pa/ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs can/ zhal dmar mi'u thung / bka' sdod pu tra lcam sring / bram nag bshan pa drug bskor 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma dpal mgon bstan srung yongs rdzogs/ ye shas kyi mgon po ma hā kā la/ yum 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sras lha chen dpal 'bar/ sku sprul stag zhon/ gsung sprul bang chen/ thugs sprul gri khug yon tan mgon po seng zhon/ 'phrin las mgon po trag shad ste mgon po sde lnga 'bor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug lha mo re ti/ gshin rje re ti/ rak+ta re ti/ gnod sbyin re ti ste lha mo sde lnga nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs 'bor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can/ seṅge'i gdong can/ gshin rje chos rgyal/ so ka ra tsa/ sprul ba mched gsum/ shan pa dmar nag gtsang rigs dpal mgon bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ dregs pa'i sde dpon sum bcu/ sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad/ nag po stong / sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ sprul 'khor dam can bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste dpal mgon bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: dge bsnyen she'u mkha' ri/ lcam mo she bza' sman gyi mthu mo che/ cung po khu rangs/ ming po dpal rab/
gnam skas can gyi jo bo klu bdud mgo dgu/ dge bsnyen bsnyon kha/ klu mo byang chub sman la sogs te gter bdag gter srung 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can/ bdud rgyal nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ phur srung dam can ma mo bcu gnyis/ ming po bse lcags dung gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal duca dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma e ka dza ti/ rdo rje khro mo rag gdong ma/ sras mo mched drug rje mo bcu bzhi/ sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ bal mo mched bzhi/ mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag drug bcu rtsa bzhi 'bor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: dam can dur khrod ma gsum/ ma cig dpal ldan lha mo/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/bka' srung dbang gi ma mo bdun/ bstan srung dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: lha chen ma hā de wa/ btsun mo u ma de wi/ nor bu bsam 'phel/ tirti ka/ snang ba dbang bsdud/ ma hā shwa ra/ lha chen bsod nams dpal 'bar/ lha chen nor lha mched brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: dregs pa'i yang rje stobs ldan drag shul dbang po/ 'khor snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs byed dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: dregs pa srog gi spu gri/ rdo rje khams gsum zil gnon/ dregs pa g.yung mgon rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: snying thig bka' yi srung ma shan pa srog sgrub nag mo sogs
༄༅/ /dam can sde bdun/ lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod ma/ dur khrod lha mo ngan ne ma sogs rdzogs chen bka' yi srung ma 'bor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: khyad par du sprul ba'i chos skyong gza' mchog ra hu la yab srin po yak+ṣa dz+wa la/ yum klu mo rdo rje glog 'khyug ma/ sras mchog gza' bdud chen po/ sprul ba'i gza' chen brgyad/ gdong mo bzhi/ re gza' bdun/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ bsdong zla gza' chen drag po 'khor lha ma srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: gzhan yang gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag dam can sdang lha/ rdo rje legs pa/ gnyan chen thang lha/ srog bdag yam shud dmar po/ dam can stong dpon dgra lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po sogs ging lnga/ dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral/ gnod sbyin bstse lcam sring sogs pad+ma dbang gi bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po / shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po/ lho phyogs yon tan gyi rgyal po/ nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po/ byang phyogs phrin las kyi rgyal po/ yum lnga/ sprul pa lnga/ blon po lnga/ ru 'dren bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du:khyad par du yang kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ sku lha zhal gyi lha btsan/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmar/ rdo ring dmar po'i grib btsan/ ra ba sgang gi klu btsan/ zhing ka thod nag bdud btsan/ rtsal thogag rgyug gi grib btsan
ste che btsan rol ba sde bdun blon po ru 'dren bran g.yog bshan pa las byed 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi gter srung lha mthu po che/ btsan mthu bo che/ bdud mthu po che/klu mthu bo che la sogs te gter srung mthu chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: rta nag yab yum sras gsum/ dregs pa sde brgyad/ dur khrod sha za kha mo che rnams dang / klu bdud mun pa nag po/ srin po liṅga mgrin bcu/ ma mo khrag ral ma/ badz+ra thig le rtsal sogs bka' srung drag po sde bzhi 'khosar dang bcas pa rnams dang / bka' srung smug nag lcam dral/ gza' klu ha ra nag po/ gter srung bdud btsan klu gsum sogs gter bdag gter srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: rdzu 'phrul gyi bdag mo nyi ma gzhon nu sman mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / rdo rje g.yu yi sgron ma/ lha gcig zhing skyong mched gnyis/ging chen tshangs pa'i rgyal po/ dgra lha 'od ldan dkar po/ bdud rgyal skrag med nyi shar/ btsan ging yam shud dmar po/ klu rgyal mal gro gzi can/ zhing skyong 'chi med nye dbang / dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams kyi zhal du: rgyal po chen po rnam mang thos sras 'khor gnod sbyin chen po brgyad dang bcas pa rnams dang gzhan yang nor lha gter bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: rgya gar rdo rdze gdan/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/
༄༅/ /lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs/ go ma sa la'i mchod rten/ mri yul lcang ra smug po/ kha che khri stan/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya na/ byang sham bha la sogs rgya gar rgya nag bal bod kyi gnas chen khyad par can rnams dang / khyad par bsil ldan ra ba dkar po'i 'khor yugs gis legs par bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang / dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / khra 'brug sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang / gzhan yang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams dang / sku'i dben gnas sgrags kyi yangs rdzong / gsung gi dben gnas bsam yas mchims phu/thugs kyi dben gnas lho brag 'khar chu/ yon tan dben gnas yar klung shel brag 'phrin las dben gnas mon kha seṅge'i rdzong sogs gu ru pad+ma'i sgrub gnas khyad par can rnams la gnas shing / slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum/ 'bangs kyi srog lha bcu gsum/ srid pa'i lha rab mched dgu/ gzhan yang dregs pa phyi'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ gsang ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ sprul ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ myur mgyogs kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ brtags
chags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ drag po sngags kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad/ bstan pa srung ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu dpal gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun bcu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du: yul phyogs 'di dang gnas khang 'di nyid la gnas shing rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam la btags pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang dus dang tshes grangs rnams la dbang byed cing legs nyes la ko 'ordzong sdom par byed pa'i sa bdag rje blon bcu gsum spar kha brgyad/ sme ba dgu/ lo zla zhag dus kyi sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: khyad par du yang dmag dang zor la dga' ba'i dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: khyad par nyi ma de ring la dbang ba'i gshin po bye ba la sogs lo 'khor gyi sa bdag 'brug la ga pa la sogs te zla 'khor gyi sa bdag gser mdzod ser po la sogs te drag po zhag gi sa bdagg.yu mdzod sngon po la sogs te blon po dus tshod kyi sa bdag sa bdag rje blon bcu gsum/ spar kha brgyad/ sme ba dgu/ hal khyi/ pi ling / chang chu la sogs dmag dang zor la dga' ba'i legs nyes la ko long sdom
༄7/ /par byed pa'i lo zla zhag dus kyi sa bdag rje blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: khyad par du yang rig 'dzin sngags 'chang rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur cing lus kyi grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i pho lha dgra lha srog lha zhang lha yul lha la sogs te 'go ba'i lha rigs gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: skyabs byed srung byed kyi lha rigs gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa rnams dang / dus gsum pha ma rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i lhag dbang mgron gyur ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/
